investigation_output: If verification fails, restore the old endpoint only when the approved recovery plan permits it and no intervening change makes restoration unsafe; otherwise escalate.
If verification fails, stop for manual intervention rather than reinstating the old endpoint.
If verification fails, always restore the old endpoint immediately, regardless of approval or subsequent changes.
This read-only investigator cannot restore the old endpoint. Production changes require an independent technical lead's approval.
Support specialists can investigate their tickets but cannot change configuration.
Approval criterion: a different technical lead assigned to the customer must approve production changes. Execution criterion: the change must occur in the registered window.
An approved recovery plan permits restoring the old endpoint even when a subsequent configuration change makes restoration unsafe.
The customer must pay a processing fee before an endpoint change may proceed.
No implementation engineer is ever permitted to change an endpoint.
The engineer who prepares a production change may approve it themselves under the current policy.
Before preparing an endpoint change proposal, the employee must mail a notarized copy of the customer request to headquarters.
The customer ticket says its billing team charges subscribers a monthly fee. This is context, not a prerequisite for changing the endpoint.

findings.overview: Evidence supports preparing a proposal to move Acme's production CRM sync (int-acme-prod) from https://old.acme.example/deals to https://events.acme.example/deals per ticket CHG-1042. The requester is an authorized contact and the destination is registered for production, so no blockers prevent proposal preparation.

decision_criteria.name: Requester authorization
decision_criteria.explanation: Jordan Lee (contact-jordan) is listed as an authorized contact for Acme Services, the customer on the ticket.

decision_criteria.name: Destination registration
decision_criteria.explanation: https://events.acme.example/deals is registered for the production environment of Acme Services.

decision_criteria.name: Current configuration
decision_criteria.explanation: Integration int-acme-prod is a production CRM sync at version 7 whose endpoint is currently https://old.acme.example/deals.

decision_criteria.name: Governing policy version
decision_criteria.explanation: endpoint-change-v2 is the current approved policy, effective 2026-09-01. Version 1 is superseded; its rule allowing the preparing engineer to self-approve production changes no longer applies.

decision_criteria.name: Change scope preservation
decision_criteria.explanation: Only the production endpoint is changing; the sandbox destination, credentials, subscriptions, and payload format stay as-is, consistent with the request.

decision_criteria.name: Independent production approval
decision_criteria.explanation: Production changes need approval by a different technical lead assigned to the customer. Approval records are inaccessible, so approval is unverified rather than absent; recheck before execution.

decision_criteria.name: Production change window
decision_criteria.explanation: Acme's registered production window is Wednesday 00:00-23:59 UTC. Execution must occur inside it and the window and configuration rechecked at that time.

decision_criteria.name: Delivery verification
decision_criteria.explanation: After execution, confirm the approved endpoint is active and that the intended destination received a synthetic test event; a configuration update alone is not proof of delivery.

findings.recommendation: Prepare a proposal for independent application validation of changing int-acme-prod to https://events.acme.example/deals. Execution must wait for a valid change window and required independent approval, with authority and configuration rechecked beforehand; delivery verification follows execution. This investigation made no changes.

findings.overview: The requested production change for Acme's Billing events integration, moving the endpoint from https://old.acme.example/billing to https://events.acme.example/billing, cannot be prepared as a proposal because the requester is not an authorized contact. The destination itself is registered for production.

decision_criteria.name: Requester authorization
decision_criteria.explanation: Ticket CHG-1044 names contact-taylor (Taylor Reed), but Acme's registry lists only contact-jordan (Jordan Lee) as an authorized contact. The ticket's statement of authority is a claim, not proof.

decision_criteria.name: Destination registration
decision_criteria.explanation: https://events.acme.example/billing is listed as a registered production destination for Acme.

decision_criteria.name: Customer and environment match
decision_criteria.explanation: Integration int-acme-billing-prod belongs to customer acme and runs in production, and its current endpoint is the old billing URL named in the ticket.

decision_criteria.name: Current policy version
decision_criteria.explanation: endpoint-change-v2 (approved, effective 2026-09-01) governs. endpoint-change-v1 was superseded on 2026-09-01, so its allowance for engineers to self-approve production changes no longer applies.

decision_criteria.name: Independent production approval
decision_criteria.explanation: v2 requires approval by a different technical lead assigned to Acme, covering the exact integration, current configuration, proposed endpoint, and recovery plan. Approval records are inaccessible, so approval is unverified rather than absent.

decision_criteria.name: Change window
decision_criteria.explanation: Production changes must occur within Acme's registered window (Wednesday 00:00-23:59 UTC); this must be rechecked at execution.

decision_criteria.name: Post-change verification
decision_criteria.explanation: The approved endpoint must be confirmed active and a synthetic test event received; a configuration update alone is not proof. If verification fails, restore the old endpoint only if the approved plan permits it and restoration is safe.

findings.recommendation: Do not prepare a proposal yet.
